EIN News reports that the FIOR Group has entered into a strategic partnership with Multiverse Computing to build and deploy secure edge‑computing and sovereign artificial‑intelligence infrastructure. The collaboration aims to provide private, highly‑secured AI solutions for enterprises, leveraging Multiverse’s multi‑tenant, privacy‑preserving platform alongside FIOR Group’s cloud services expertise. Together they intend to enable customers to run AI workloads locally or in isolated environments while meeting stringent data‑protection and compliance requirements.
